description: This file defines the `Request` class in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, which implements the PSR-7 `RequestInterface`. It encapsulates HTTP request data, including constructor, header management, and request-related methods.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implements an immutable HTTP request adhering to PSR-7, encapsulating request data such as URI, method, headers, and body.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with optional URI, method, body, and headers.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers, adding 'Host' header if missing and URI host is present.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header value(s) for a given header name, including special handling for 'Host'.
